title: The flyer, drawn
logline: The twenty-eighth flyer being drawn at Gully's counter by the girl, fifteen, from behind: the crab in its corner, the pencil, the tin. Nine days before it's pinned. The page watches it made.

panels.composition: A fifteen-year-old girl from behind at a shop counter drawing a small crab in the corner of a paper flyer in pencil, a pushpin tin beside her.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a fifteen-year-old girl seen from behind at a shop counter drawing a small crab in pencil in the corner of a paper flyer with a pushpin tin beside her, no words legible
